signal: Openforce launched a new AI-based user portal and announced TMS integrations with Key Software Systems and Dispatch Science.

email.body1:
Ben, saw Openforce launched the AI user portal and added TMS integrations with Key Software and Dispatch Science.

New integrations open new account segments, and that usually means more in-market enterprises than the team can cover before reps ramp, so deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so enterprise coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Openforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ben, quick follow-up for Openforce.

As the enterprise sales lead you feel coverage pressure first: more named accounts in play than reps can reach in a quarter. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the enterprise number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Openforce needs to cover that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ben, last bit of proof for Openforce.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Openforce's reply rate likely compares to peer B2B platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ben, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new integrations and chasing enterprise deals is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Openforce either way.
